items.banks: The accounts payouts leave from: holder, number, IFSC, purpose — one row per account, per company.
items.roles: What each role may do, derived from surface/Authorisation.php and read-only here; a change is a reviewed code edit (Law 5).
items.branding: Each company's logo, colour and logo text previewed on the sidebar and a document heading; the fields are the companies row.
items.smtp-settings: One mail server per company — host, port, encryption, credentials, From. Stored, never sent from here.
items.my-subscription: Plan, seats in use against seats bought, period end and days left — read from the subscription row, changed commercially.
items.general-settings: Every config/*.json rule file with whether this organisation customised it, by whom, when; edits happen on the owning screen.
items.sys-updates: Installed version from config/version.json, licence edition, AMC validity and licence events; updates are the operator's act.
items.probation-settings: Default months and reminder milestones over config/probation.json, saved as a new version each time.
items.mobile-devices: Phones registered for the attendance app: approve, reject with a reason, revoke a lost one — moves declared in config/mobile-devices.json.
